More critically, [@lehmann2011biochar] is described as finding that biochar 'promote root colonisation by mycorrhizal fungi' - a specific mechanistic claim not evident from the paper title ('Biochar effects on soil biota — A review'). The agent fabricated specific findings from papers it never actually read.
